properties.text: The build runs as a job: it goes on when this window, or the app, is closed.
An image the new one starts as a copy of, or a macOS restore file to install macOS from.

A copy keeps what its image has, the Full Disk Access grant included, and takes about a minute before its tools are installed. From a restore file, macOS is installed anew (about 6 minutes), and Full Disk Access is granted once afterwards.

properties.title: Add a Recipe File...
properties.help: Add a recipe file of your own to the list: a recipe.json in its folder, or any JSON recipe.

properties.text: A recipe runs its steps inside the image, some as root. Add only one you wrote or have read.
Lower-case letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-", starting with a letter or a digit.

properties.title: Build
properties.help: Start the build as a job, and open its progress window. The job goes on when this app is closed.
